title: PUSD
tagline: Another ERC-20 that's pegged to the Dollar based on a published contract
description: I was just looking at this for fun and looked around the code :) This was my first hackathon so I just focused more on the environment and vibe. I also learned about blockchain technologies like cheaper fees and faster transactions. Some of the privacy related options were interesting but I was not really able to implement those. I think the space is growing even though the market is low.
how_its_made: Used a open source erc-20 contract developed by Gemini. This was the closest project that was related to Ethereum that I knew of so I worked on it. I did not use any sponsor technologies. The project is mostly source code that I tried to learn about and didn't really try to deploy.
